text: {"findings":[{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Vague success metrics","detail":"\"Driver happiness\" and \"Faster handoffs\" are not canonical, defined metrics. It is unclear how they are measured (survey score vs. handoff time at pickup).","evidence_quote":"Driver happiness: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Use glossary-defined metrics such as a named driver satisfaction score and a specific pickup wait time or handoff duration metric, with definitions."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"No baseline, numeric target, or timeframe","detail":"Success metrics only say \"improve\" with no baseline value, numeric target, or timeframe for achieving it.","evidence_quote":"Faster handoffs: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"State the current baseline, a numeric target (e.g., reduce median pickup wait from X to Y minutes), and the time window for measuring it."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Missing delivery-quality and driver guardrails","detail":"The change affects pickup timing and driver behavior, yet the only guardrail is cost. There are no guardrails for delivery time, order lateness, driver earnings or utilization, or driver retention, and \"must not increase\" has no threshold.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as delivery time/late rate, driver earnings per hour, order cancellation or order quality, and driver retention, each with thresholds."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"MDE unit unclear and design details incomplete","detail":"The MDE of \"1 point\" is not tied to any defined metric, and the primary metric is unspecified, so the power claim cannot be validated. Randomizing by store cluster without a stated number of clusters or a check for driver spillover across clusters risks leakage, since drivers work across stores.","evidence_quote":"Randomized by store cluster. Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 1 point, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Name the primary metric, define the MDE in its units with a baseline variance, state the cluster count, and show that drivers do not cross arms or account for it in the analysis."}]}
